notes.text: Colton Parayko is day to day (upper body injury) and missed their last game. Brandon Carlo has taken his spot beside Philip Broberg.

Logan Mailloux is out long term and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Adam Jiříček has taken his spot beside Philip Broberg. That pair has had 65% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 80:05 together.
Aleksanteri Kaskimäki was added to the roster on Oct 18 and has played beside Pius Suter and Otto Stenberg.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 6th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Daemon Hunt joined from MIN on Oct 25 and has played beside Jayden Struble.
Adam Edström has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 14 games, up from 1% with his old team last season.

stakes: The Blues and the Predators go in level on 15 points, fifth and fifth in the Central in the Central. A win in regulation would put either one ahead of the other.

story.head: Round two in Nashville
paras: The Predators won the teams’ first meeting this season, 5-2 in Nashville on Oct 17. The Preds (5-4-5) beat Tampa Bay 5-4 in a shootout on Oct 31, and the Blues have won two in a row. This is a Central Division matchup, with the Blues fifth (tied for 19th in the NHL) and the Predators sixth (tied for 19th).

The Blues have played better than their record (.536) says: their chances are worth about .593, and their goaltending has held them back. The Predators’ record (.536) is about what their chances are worth.

The Blues (lowest) and the Predators (3rd lowest) both keep things calm after the whistle. The Blues keep dangerous shots away better than anyone (1st). They also have struggled on the power play (32nd), so their struggling power play gets a tough test from the Predators’ penalty killers. As for the Predators, they get pinned in their own end on long shifts (32nd) and ice the puck a lot (29th).

Dylan Holloway (3 G / 9 A / 12 P in 14 GP) leads the Blues in scoring, and Jimmy Snuggerud (8 G / 3 A / 11 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals. For the Predators, Filip Forsberg (5 G / 12 A / 17 P in 14 GP) leads the way in scoring, with nine points in his last five games and twelve goals in twelve games against St. Louis since 2023-24. Steven Stamkos (8 G / 8 A / 16 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals.

Joel Hofer (6-3-1 / .917 SV% in 10 GS) has been terrific for St. Louis and will likely start. Juuse Saros (3-3-4 / .902 SV% in 10 GS) is in line to start for Nashville. Hofer has a .866 save percentage in seven starts against the Predators, well under his usual .911. Don’t read much into it: a goalie’s record against one team rarely holds up.
At home, Andrew Brunette likes to send Höglander, Wood and Forsberg out against opponents’ third lines, so watch for them against Holloway, Dvorský and McMichael.
